text:
**EVERY ROW THE TABLE EXPOSES ON MCP CAN ACTUALLY BE SERVED, AND THE ROW SAYS WHICH FACADE METHOD SERVES IT.** Minted by vc 2026-08-30 on ic's ask, because the drive it names was real work on WP-09's critical path with no home in any artefact -- **and scope that arrives through conversation and never reaches the artefact is invisible to every instrument the estate owns**, which is `AC-08.9`'s own lesson applied to the thread that recorded it.

**THE CRITERION IS AGREEMENT, NOT COVERAGE, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE WHOLE DESIGN.** It does NOT say all 94 exposed rows must gain a facade method. It says **exposed implies servable** -- so it closes either by BUILDING the missing methods or by NARROWING `exposed_on_mcp`, and which one happens becomes a visible decision instead of a default. **A criterion demanding 94 methods would force scope at the tag; this one makes the choice legible and leaves it with hv.**

**WHY IT IS DECLARED PER ROW RATHER THAN DERIVED (vc's ruling 2026-08-30, on ic's measurement).** The mapping is not computable from the verb: 94 exposed rows against 84 `pub fn` on `Facade`, matched path-with-underscores against method name, gives **40 hit and 54 miss** -- and it breaks on `fc`, the row the ruling used as its own example. The misses are ordinary, not exotic: `st edit`, `ac status`, `ac gate`, `at green`, `issues list`, `todo`, `agents sync`, `lang init`. **That is `AC-09.1`'s own argument -- *DECLARED per row, never derived from the verb* -- arriving a third time with a number on it.** The alternative considered and refused was a mapping table in Rust beside the generator: that is the hand-maintained command list `AC-09.4` forbids, one file away from the generator that renders `AC-09.4`.

**ONE METHOD PER ROW, AND WHERE NONE EXISTS THE ANSWER IS TO ADD ONE -- NEVER TO COMPOSE IN THE TIER.** A tool that composes several facade calls puts logic in the MCP tier that the CLI arm already carries, which is the Thin Coordinator violation the *MCP calls the facade* ruling was made to avoid. **So a row with no single door is a FACADE GAP to close, not a field to make expressive.** First subject: `fc`, which has four (`ac_fc`, `at_fc`, `st_fc`, `wp_fc`) and whose CLI arm does the kind dispatch by hand -- issue `0171`, and a live CLI defect predating WP-09.

**AND A ONE-WAY MUTATION MUST NOT BE EXPOSED WITHOUT A DOOR.** Advertising a destructive tool that can only ever error is the worst instance of the finding that opened this line of work, so an exposed one-way row with no facade method is a falsifier of this criterion rather than a row awaiting one.

**WHAT WOULD FALSIFY THIS: any `exposed_on_mcp: true` row that names no facade method, or names one that does not exist.**

**THE DRIVE IS A MANUAL READ OF ~94 ARMS AND THAT IS THE HONEST COST (M at least), MEASURED RATHER THAN ESTIMATED.** ic built a resolver over `render.rs` three times and it was structurally wrong three times -- a `fn` regex anchored at column 0 that missed `pub fn run`; arms that are BLOCKS rather than `=> fn(` calls; an offset bug indexing the whole file with substring positions -- and the root cause is that **naive brace matching cannot find an arm body in `render.rs`, because `{` and `}` inside `format!` literals are indistinguishable from block braces without a real lexer.** Each intermediate version produced a plausible split. **Three known answers run as controls every time is what stopped a guess reaching this row as a measurement**, and building a Rust lexer to avoid reading 94 lines is the wrong trade.
